requirements.title: Core courses
requirements.summary: Complete both core courses for six semester hours.

requirements.title: Approved electives
requirements.summary: Current linked Mendoza page: choose at least nine semester hours from these 34 electives. Catalog differs; see source-conflict note.

requirements.title: Eligibility and application
requirements.summary: Open to Mendoza College of Business majors.

requirements.title: Major overlap limit
requirements.summary: Up to three credits from the student’s major(s) may also count toward this minor. Some electives may satisfy Mendoza broadening requirements; consult an advisor.

requirements.title: Class applicability and application
requirements.summary: Open under this title to the Class of 2028 and later. Classes of 2026 and 2027 use the separate Business Technology and Analytics minor. Apply during the fall or spring application window.

requirements.title: Catalog elective observation — reconciliation pending
requirements.summary: The catalog records nine elective hours but its heading says choose six credits from ITAO; it lists these 30 courses. This is a separate source observation, not an additional requirement or permission to combine pools. MARK 30500 and ITAO 50850 appear only in the catalog among the two current sources.

requirements.title: Catalog-only elective enrollment restrictions
requirements.summary: ITAO 50850 requires ITAO 40250 and 40420 and a Business Analytics program; MARK 30500 requires MARK 20100 and Marketing/Mendoza enrollment. Being listed as an AI minor elective does not itself waive these restrictions.

requirements.title: Minor total
requirements.summary: Complete 15 semester hours in the core and eligible electives.

requirements.title: University grading rule and college wording conflict
requirements.summary: University Code §3.3.11 excludes declared-program courses from the elective pass/fail option and bars pass/fail from satisfying program requirements. Mendoza’s BBA paragraph mentions an exception for the first course of a minor while also prohibiting business courses; applicability requires clarification.

requirements.title: Outside-course approval
requirements.summary: Before enrollment elsewhere, obtain dean/designee approval. Transfer requires C or better (not C-minus), standard letter grading, applicable nonduplicative content, and institutional/delivery review. Online courses require an appropriate synchronous component; the dean determines application to the credential.

requirements.title: Cross-college double counting
requirements.summary: For credentials across colleges, overlap requires both deans’ approval. The program’s three-hour major-overlap cap still applies.

requirements.title: Repeat limits
requirements.summary: Unless designated repeatable, only failed courses or approved D-grade courses may be repeated; credit counts once and both grades affect GPA. A D course may be repeated once, with two such repeats over the undergraduate career.

requirements.title: College completion constraint
requirements.summary: Mendoza students must complete added minors within four years. The BBA’s degree-wide GPA/residency requirements are not relabeled as minor-specific limits.

requirements.title: Mendoza pass-fail wording — applicability unresolved
requirements.summary: The BBA paragraph permits juniors/seniors one non-business elective per term with academic-adviser permission and assistant-dean approval, selected in the first six days and irrevocable. It excludes business/required/second-major/minor courses but parenthetically excepts a first minor-track course. This source-specific observation does not override the university code or grant an AI-minor exception, especially for students outside Mendoza.

requirements.title: Core Courses
requirements.summary: Catalog core-course observation; compare with the current Mendoza page before adopting a changed inventory.

requirements.title: AI & Analytics Core Electives (choose 6 credits from ITAO):
requirements.summary: Catalog elective observation: 6 credits from ITAO within the listed elective block. The current program page differs; this is not an automatically merged approved pool.

requirements.title: Catalog total observation
requirements.summary: Source-specific total; not an additional block to add to the primary curriculum.

notes: The current sidebar-linked /ai-analytics-in-business-minor/ page has 36 courses (two core plus 34 electives). The older /ai-analytics-in-business/ page remains provenance, not the current elective pool. Its ITAO 30530 and ITAO 50840 codes are not silently equated to current ITAO 40530 and catalog ITAO 50850. Prior same-title MARK 30120/30130 entries are corrected using the current page: Marketing Research / Marketing Analytics.

Catalog and current program page differ: two catalog-only choices, six current-page-only choices, and a catalog six-ITAO-credit subheading within a nine-credit elective block. Both pools are represented as separate source observations; neither union nor automatic substitution is certified.
Course amount normalization uses Academic Code §5.4.2. All 38 recorded course amounts have explicit source evidence; no conversion or default three-credit assumption is used.

Most course descriptions and formal prerequisites remain unverified; explicit recommendations are not converted into requirements. Catalog-only courses have enrollment restrictions. Source categories remain analyst taxonomy.

2026-10-11 reinspection confirms the unresolved source wording/list issue. Secondary parsers now observe the current catalog pool and pass-fail paragraph independently; blank catalog hours do not overwrite reviewed course amounts. No source-precedence rule authorizing a merged pool or grading exception was found in these sections.
